items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Just like little George Lewis, the same way.

ctx.x: Just like little George Lewis, the same way. Take little George Lewis. And the cousin was telling us Chris Kelly. Chris Kelly's band. Well, we'd play, and he'd ask, but it'd hire me extra. Because I could always show them music and things. It'd always hire me extra. Pair me right. It's, uh, they had a nickname they used to call me, too. All the fellas had a nickname. They used to call me a horse. The horse, you mind my little cousin, sat inside you. He's living right today, George. Nice little fella. Well, Chris…
Are you self-taught on that, or did somebody show you how to play saxophone?
